title: roohe aqeel kehti thi dilbar hua shaheed
body:
roohe aqeel kehti thi dilbar hua shaheed
wa hasrata ke muslime bepar hua shaheed
ahle dagha ghareeb se ek dafa phir gaye
ghurbat naseeb bekaso bepar hua shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya tha raahe raast dikhaane ke waaste
kya jaane kis qata pe dilaawar hua shaheed
kuffaar ne gira diya baalaaye baam se
haye haye ghareeb bekaso muztar hua shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ke zulmo jor ki had kuch na puchiye
koofe me rishtadaare payambar hua shaheed
itna to koofiyo se koi jaake puchta
kya mil gaya jo bekaso muztar hua shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain quld me hai ali o wali ki rooh
kehte hai mustafa mera dilbar hua shaheed
ibne aqeel koofe me be yaar o ghamgusaar
ehle jafaa ke zulm uthaa kar hua shaheed
